We conjecture that the supercongruence u(n*p^r) == u(n*p^(r-1)) (mod p^(3*r)) holds for all positive integers n and r and all primes p >= 5. Cf. A380582. - _Peter Bala_, Jan 21 2025

See A380290. - _Peter Bala_, Feb 02 2025
